FIELDS.NAME: Green Horizon Landscaping Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Horizon Landscaping Services specializes in providing comprehensive garden and landscaping solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations focus primarily on routine lawn care maintenance, landscape design, and planting services, ensuring the utmost quality and care in all projects. We prioritize safety and compliance with all local regulations, employing trained personnel who utilize approved materials and follow best practices. We maintain established relationships with licensed nurseries and utilize reputable suppliers for all our landscaping materials. Our commitment to environmental responsibility includes applying pesticides and herbicides only as necessary and with proper certifications, further ensuring safe and sustainable practices.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 10, 2023, while performing routine lawn maintenance at a residential property, our crew accidentally damaged a decorative fence during the installation of new plants. The cost to repair the fence was $1,200. This claim has been resolved, and the payment was successfully received from our liability insurance.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Sunday Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe with UL Class 350 fire rating, Grade 1 lock, and secure alarm monitoring system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system with video surveillance and regular security inspections.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Our operations do not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We apply pesticides and herbicides only as necessary and in compliance with proper certifications, keeping such activities incidental to our primary landscaping services.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not sponsor any athletic teams. Our focus is primarily on providing landscaping and garden services to our clients.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Our Operations Manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking and verifying these certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes in connection with this or any other property involving our company. We maintain a commitment to ethical business practices and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The company has maintained a strong insurance record with no lapses in coverage.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not lease employees to or from other employers. We maintain our own staff to ensure consistent quality and control over our services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Green Horizon Landscaping Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees while on the job.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing garden and landscaping services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not have any other insurance policies with this company. All coverage is provided under the current policy indicated.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging products. Our focus is solely on providing garden and landscaping services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is on providing landscaping services directly to our clients.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The company maintains a strong financial standing and has a solid operational history.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond occasional incidental use of approved pesticides and herbicides, which are handled in compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations focus primarily on routine landscaping and maintenance without high-risk activities. We prioritize safety and compliance in all aspects of our services.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our commitment to ethical practices ensures a respectful and compliant workplace.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has no uncorrected fire code violations. We prioritize safety and compliance with all local regulations.
